requirements.text: The MDD justifies the use of an ML technique, describing the expected benefit over conventional techniques and the additional risks introduced.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: The full development pipeline is executable from version-controlled code with fixed random seeds and a recorded software environment, so that results can be reproduced.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: Representativeness of the development data is demonstrated against the current portfolio; a PSI above 0.25 on the score or any of the ten most important features is explained and its impact assessed.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: Data are split into development and test samples before feature selection or tuning, and the test sample includes an out-of-time portion covering at least the most recent twelve months of outcomes.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: Every feature is constructed point-in-time using only information available at the prediction date; features derived from the target, post-event information or outcome-triggered processes are not used.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: Any feature with univariate AUC above 0.90 against the target, or whose removal reduces model AUC by more than five percentage points, has a documented leakage review.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: The RDS documentation analyses sources of bias in the data, including historical decision bias, label bias, under-representation and measurement bias, and documents mitigation measures and their effect.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: Every model feature is recorded in the Feature Register with definition, source system, lineage, transformation logic, business rationale, owner and availability at prediction time.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: Protected attributes are not used as model features.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to ML models whose outputs affect natural persons.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: Features are screened for proxy effects; a feature predicting a protected attribute with AUC above 0.65 or Cramér's V above 0.30 is removed or retained with a justification approved by the AI Governance Office.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to ML models whose outputs affect natural persons.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: Engineered features of Tier 1 models have an economic or behavioural interpretation; uninterpretable automatically generated features are not used.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: Feature selection is performed on the development sample only, and features with mean absolute SHAP below 1% of the total are removed unless retained for a documented business reason.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: The hyperparameter search space, search method, objective and selection criterion are documented, and tuning uses only the development sample, never the test sample.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: Overfitting is controlled through regularisation, early stopping, complexity constraints or equivalent techniques, and the controls applied are documented.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: The Gini gap between development and test samples is reported; a gap above five percentage points is justified and a gap above ten percentage points is not accepted for production.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: Monotonic constraints are imposed in the algorithm for features whose direction of effect is established by the risk logic, and the constraint choices are documented.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to credit risk models, where risk logic establishes the direction of the main risk drivers.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: Compliance with monotonic constraints and plausibility of the learned relationships are verified with partial dependence or ICE analysis on the test sample.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: Global SHAP importance on the test sample and dependence plots for at least the ten most important features are presented, confirming the main drivers are consistent with business expectations.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: Local explanations are available for every prediction used in a decision, and for Tier 1 or customer- and alert-level decision models the local SHAP values are stored with each production prediction.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: Models whose outputs lead to decisions communicated to customers or reviewed by analysts produce ranked reason codes mapped to documented, business-reviewed standard statements.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: The fidelity of the explanation method is tested, including SHAP additivity to the model output and stability of explanations for similar inputs.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: Fairness is tested before approval and at every periodic review, covering at least sex and age group and other protected attributes where lawfully available.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to ML models whose outputs affect natural persons.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: The ratio of favourable-outcome rates between the least and most favoured group is at least 0.80.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to ML models whose outputs affect natural persons.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: The difference in true-positive rates between groups does not exceed five percentage points, and calibration by group is reported for probability models.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to ML models whose outputs affect natural persons.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: Fairness threshold breaches are analysed for root cause and mitigated or justified by a documented risk rationale, with AI Governance Office approval for retention.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to ML models whose outputs affect natural persons.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: Stability is demonstrated across time periods, segments and repeated training with different seeds; for Tier 1 models the Gini standard deviation across five seeds does not exceed one percentage point.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: The model is benchmarked against a simpler interpretable model on the same data and target; with a Gini uplift below two percentage points the simpler model is preferred unless otherwise justified.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: The MDD defines the retraining approach: triggers, frequency, data window, the pipeline elements that may change and the acceptance tests a retrained model must pass.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: No continuous or online learning is used in production for Tier 1 and Tier 2 models.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).

requirements.text: Input drift is monitored with the PSI on the score and top ten features, at least monthly for real-time models and quarterly otherwise, with amber above 0.10 and red above 0.25.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-700 v1.3).
